# Tectonic 0.17.0

ModuTeX packages the official Windows x64 binary from the Tectonic 0.17.0 release. The acquisition workflow verifies the archive against `f61ce51f0b0ade1015b7de7ef368541c5424e9756ecbd0d7af97d6d48030845f` before extraction. Tectonic remains under the terms in `TECTONIC-LICENSE.txt`; ModuTeX does not modify the executable.
